text:
aj: Heads-up — PR #17890 (feature/graphql-cache-opt) is green locally but stuck on cross-region CI. APAC job hung on e2e for ~2h. We have a rebase window in ~3h and a deploy freeze at 02:00 UTC. Do we try to rerun just the failing job or hold the merge until after the freeze? :hourglass: 

sasha: can you paste the failing test log? if it's flaky we can rerun the single job, but if it's a real regression we should hold. what's the job name?

aj: build-bot posted it — job is `e2e:browser:apac` in the gpu-matrix. last logs show a timeout on chromedriver: `ERROR Timeout waiting for selector '.app-root'`

build-bot: CI update: PR #17890 — e2e:browser:apac — failed after 2h03m — flaky history: 6/40 in last 30d. Rerun allowed.

maria-ops: If it's flaky history 15% then rerun makes sense. But note rebase window is tight — if you rerun and it still fails we'll likely miss the slot. Suggest: trigger a single rerun now, and if it passes we can coordinate a quick rebase+merge with @ryan on approvals. If it fails, we hold and schedule for next canary.

aj: ok triggering single job rerun now: `./scripts/ci retry --pr 17890 --job e2e:browser:apac`

build-bot: Rerun queued (job id 845392). ETA ~12m.

sasha: also consider running `npm run smoke:e2e -- --filter=apac` against the branch in a remote ephemeral to reproduce faster before wasting full CI. I can spin one up if you want.

aj: that would be great. if you can repro, we save the rerun slot. thanks.

sasha: spinning ephemeral now — will post URL in ~4m.

build-bot: Rerun started (job id 845392).

aj: quick note — once it's green i need @ryan to approve since there are schema changes. @ryan can you do a fast review if all CI passes?

ryan: I can be on standby. If it passes ping me and i'll give a quick look. If you need to bypass review for the slot, we should doc it in the PR comment.

build-bot: Rerun success (job id 845392) — e2e:browser:apac passed in 11m12s.

aj: awesome. rebase in progress: `git pull --rebase origin main && git push -f` — will ping when done.

sasha: ephemeral repro didn't hit the timeout. looks flaky on CI infra. no code change needed.

aj: rebase done and pushed. @ryan — ready for quick review. Summary: only cache tuning + a tiny graphql cache ttl change. No schema migration at runtime (false alarm).

ryan: taking a quick pass. :eyes:

ryan: LGTM. leaving a comment and approving. merge when ready, but avoid the 02:00 UTC blackout — we still have ~1h20m.

aj: merging now. `gh pr merge 17890 --squash --admin` (will monitor post-merge smoke).

build-bot: Merge completed — PR #17890 merged to main by aj. Post-merge smoke triggered (smoke:main).

sasha: thanks team. notes for follow-up: open an infra issue to investigate chromedriver flakiness in apac pool (rare but recurring). tagging infra and ci-queue owners.

maria-ops: noted. i'll create a ticket and add the flaky-job history link. thanks for the fast turnaround. :tada:
